task_summary: Built the task-1036 Markov regime transition matrix (Bear/Sideways/Bull) on EURUSD daily with naive vs stride=lookback sampling; the autocorrelation fix collapses stickiness from 83.8% to 33.5% (~base rate) — regime is near-memoryless, REJECTED as an edge; from current Bear state P(next=Sideways)=41.3%.
